title: Natural equivalence of pointed-etale cocones across prime localization
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, p a prime, A = R_p [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], K a field, and χ : κ_R(p) → K [def-weil-residue-field]. Fix an A-algebra structure on K and q in Spec A with ψ : κ_A(q) → K, such that evaluation via ψ equals A → K and its restriction to R equals evaluation via χ. For the ring diagrams of pointed étale triples [def-weil-pbc-etale-residue-triples], there are equivalences E_V from R-diagram cocones with vertex V to A-diagram cocones with vertex V, for every commutative ring V. They commute with postcomposition by V → W. For each local triple t and r in R, the leg E_V(η)_t composed with t.α sends r to η at the identity R-triple applied to r. No universal cocone or algebra structure on V is assumed.

proof.text: Express A as the filtered colimit of principal localizations R_s for s outside p. Principal refinements of each pointed R-triple remain pointed R-triples, and their ring colimit is its localization at the images of R outside p.

Descend each finitely presented étale A-algebra to an étale R_s-algebra, whose pointing is restricted from K. Descend morphisms at a common stage and their equalities at a later stage; descend both directions and inverse relations for comparison isomorphisms. This makes extension of the original cocone leg to each localized model independent of the model and natural on A-triples.

The inverse sends a local-base cocone to the legs obtained by first localizing each R-triple and restricting its leg back to the original ring. Naturality on principal refinements and uniqueness of localization extensions make the two assignments inverse and commute with postcomposition. Naturality from the identity R-triple to each descended model gives agreement on R.

proof_origin.note: Second reading replaced the near-restatement by the cocone-descent step independent of any universal cocone. The parent now proves universality and the structural equations.

theorem etaleResidueTriples_primeLocalization_coconeEquiv
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (p : Spec R) (K : Type u) [Field K]
    (χ : (Spec R).residueField p ⟶ CommRingCat.of K)
    [Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) K]
    (q : Spec (CommRingCat.of (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)))
    (ψ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))).residueField q ⟶
      CommRingCat.of K)
    (hψ : (ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))).inv ≫
      (Spec (CommRingCat.of (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))).Γevaluation q ≫ ψ =
        CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) K))
    (hK : CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)) ≫
      CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) K) =
        (ΓSpecIso R).inv ≫ (Spec R).Γevaluation p ≫ χ)
    : ∃ E : ∀ V : CommRingCat.{u},
        (etaleResidueTriplesRingDiagram R p K χ ⟶ (Functor.const _).obj V) ≃
        (etaleResidueTriplesRingDiagram
          (CommRingCat.of (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)) q K ψ ⟶
            (Functor.const _).obj V),
      (∀ (V W : CommRingCat.{u}) η (f : V ⟶ W),
        E W (η ≫ (Functor.const _).map f) =
          E V η ≫ (Functor.const _).map f) ∧
      ∀ (V : CommRingCat.{u}) η
          (t : EtaleResidueTriples (CommRingCat.of (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)) q K ψ)
          (r : R),
        (t.α ≫ (E V η).app t).hom (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) r) =
          (η.app ⟨R, 𝟙 R, inferInstance, p, by simp, χ, by simp⟩).hom r
